component.name: Discagem
component.summary: Self-hosted text chat, voice channels and screen sharing

description.p: Discagem is the desktop client of a chat server you run yourself, for a group of friends or a small team. Nothing goes through third-party services.

ul.li: Text channels with formatting, mentions, images, files and profile photos
Voice channels with Opus audio, per-person volume, mute and deafen
Screen and window sharing with sound, watched by any number of people
Light and dark themes, including a glossy Aero look
